entries.text: Someone listening with a screen reader tabs into the footer and hears three stops announced only as "link" — the icons inside are hidden from them, so nothing says Facebook, X or YouTube. The same three silent stops repeat in the footer of every page, including apply, sign-in and status, so a listener must tab past unlabelled links and guess, or open them blind, to leave the page they came to use.

Someone with low vision reading the footer sees "Last updated October 3, 2026" in pale grey on white at small size — faint enough to vanish in glare or on a dim screen, leaving them unable to tell how current the benefits information is. It reads the same washed-out way on the home, apply, sign-in and status pages, so there is nowhere they can check the date reliably.
